    public static class ExecutableAdmissionHelper
    {
        public static string ComputeFileSha256(string filePath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath) || !File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException($"File not found for hash calculation: '{filePath}'");
            }
            using (var sha = SHA256.Create())
            using (var stream = File.Open(filePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite))
            {
                byte[] hash = sha.ComputeHash(stream);
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(hash.Length * 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < hash.Length; i++)
                {
                    sb.Append(hash[i].ToString("X2"));
                }
                return sb.ToString();
            }
        }

        public static (bool isValid, string error) VerifyAdmittedExecutable(string exePath, string expectedSha256)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exePath))
            {
                return (false, "Executable path cannot be null or empty.");
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedSha256) || expectedSha256.Trim().Length != 64)
            {
                return (false, "Expected SHA256 must be a 64-character hex string.");
            }
            string normalizedPath;
            try
            {
                normalizedPath = Path.GetFullPath(exePath.Trim());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return (false, $"Invalid executable path: {ex.Message}");
            }
            if (!File.Exists(normalizedPath))
            {
                return (false, $"Admitted executable file does not exist at '{normalizedPath}'.");
            }
            string actualSha;
            try
            {
                actualSha = ComputeFileSha256(normalizedPath);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return (false, $"Failed to compute executable SHA256: {ex.Message}");
            }
            if (!string.Equals(actualSha, expectedSha256.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return (false, $"Executable SHA256 mismatch. Expected='{expectedSha256.ToUpperInvariant()}', Observed='{actualSha.ToUpperInvariant()}'.");
            }
            return (true, string.Empty);
        }

        public static (bool isValid, string error) VerifyProcessIdentity(

            {

            }
            string normalizedMain;

            }
            catch (Exception ex)

            var exeCheck = VerifyAdmittedExecutable(normalizedMain, expectedSha256);
            if (!exeCheck.isValid)
